note: Private RV park on the southeast side of Clear Lake, two blocks from the shore (not on the water), near the Surf Ballroom. Concrete patio, fire ring and picnic table at each site; playground, firewood for sale. Tents not allowed. --Claude
summary: Hookups 50/W/S, showers/laundry/wifi, season Apr 15-Oct 15 and $40-45 all confirmed; booking added (phone, holiday minimum, 15-year rig rule); fee note gains cash-only and the $5 extra-person charge. Private gates pass. Not waterfront stands.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: Google 4.5 stars / 179 reviews (pass). Price $40 back-in, under the US$50 gate (no gateway needed). Presence: own website live (home page on oakwoodrvpark.net; its subpages only load from oakwood-rv-park.weebly.com) with posted rates and phone 641-357-4019, matching Google. Rig rule 'All units must be 15 years old or newer' passes for a 2023 EKKO.

LONG-STAY: nightly rates are posted and reservations are by the night; the website no longer offers monthly or seasonal rates (the old note said it did; dropped). Imagery (leaf-off, bare fields, i.e. outside or at the edge of the Apr 15-Oct 15 season) shows ~35 units packed into the north back-in section and ~10 on the south pull-through herringbone, which suggests seasonal or stored rigs on the north half. The ~40 pull-throughs the operator names are mostly empty in that frame, so overnight sites are plentiful. No drop indicated.

SITES: stored count 50 and max_rig_ft 45 (derived from the old note) are not on the operator's pages, which say only '40 large pull-through sites' plus back-ins; left. Dump station (derived) is not on the operator's pages either; left.

WEBSITE: https://www.oakwoodrvpark.net/ home page works, but /services.html, /policies.html and /amenities.html return 404 there; the weebly subdomain serves them. apply.py writes neither website nor phone.
NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: operator says 'two blocks from the shore'; no water within 200 m. Pin is at the centre of the park; fine.
